tool_args.rationale: The pilot varies drive but spans only 0.018 in s_grad, so it primarily constrains the combined amplitude vmax*(1-rho/2). The cost-2 probe adds the gradient contrast needed to separate vmax from rho and test the open branch. Fit the resulting data over the full fallback bounds rather than clipping rho to the warm-start range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the square-root siphon on the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow gradient range makes vmax and rho nearly collinear. A good pilot fit can still extrapolate poorly to wider gradients.
It costs more and does not directly address the missing gradient leverage.
It does not help distinguish the candidate mechanisms.
